http/cache_freshness#

How old a cached response is and how long it stays fresh (RFC 9111 §4.2).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let freshness = CacheFreshness(headers: response::Head::headers, timing: timing);
freshness.fresh(clock.monotonic_instant());

Description#

How old a cached response is and how long it stays fresh (RFC 9111 §4.2).

The lifetime is max-age, else Expires minus Date, else 0. The age is the larger of the apparent age and Age plus the request's delay, then grows with the monotonic clock. no-cache and no-store make a response unusable without revalidation.
